finding.mechanism: The stale explicit-feedback candidate joined an existing UnifiedDB transaction without an inner rollback boundary. A policy mutation occurs before the feedback receipt insert; if that insert fails, the caller catches the error, and the outer transaction later commits, partial learned routing could be persisted without its idempotency/provenance receipt.
finding.repair: When explicit feedback executes inside an existing SQLite transaction, wrap the feedback mutation and receipt in a unique SAVEPOINT; rollback and release that savepoint on any BaseException, while leaving the outer transaction alive for its caller.
finding.authority_boundary: MicroClay remains SHADOW accessibility/routing only; no truth, rights, serving-mode, EffectGate or EntityOS authority is added.

regression.name: test_caught_inner_feedback_failure_rolls_back_its_savepoint_only
regression.contract: Inject a retrieval_feedback insert failure, catch it inside a still-live outer UnifiedDB transaction, verify zero policy/receipt leakage, commit an unrelated outer write, then retry feedback exactly once after removing the fault.
